page_title: ATA 2-1 NAP | Atalanta v Napoli 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Daniele Chiffi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+3' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
90+1' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Matteo Politano (Napoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
85' It will be a substitution. Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Alisson Santos walks off.
85' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
84' Raffaele Palladino is forced to make a change. Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Honest Ahanor.

81' 2 - 1 Lorenzo Bernasconi showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom right corner. It's 2:1.
79' Atalanta couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Napoli) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
77' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
75' The corner from Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is intercepted by the defence.
75' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
72' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Atalanta will take a corner.
72' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle. Sam Beukema (Napoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
70' Here's the change. Juan Jesus leaves the pitch and Mathias Olivera (Napoli) comes on as a substitute.
70' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Antonio Vergara and he is replaced by Giovane (Napoli).
69' Substitution. Giorgio Scalvini will be replaced by Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta).
69' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic easily deals with the threat.
67' Alisson Santos (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
66' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
65' He should have scored! Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
63' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi will be replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
62' Substitution. Matteo Politano (Napoli) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Miguel Gutierrez walks off.
61' 1 - 1 Gooal! Nicola Zalewski takes over corner duties. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
61' The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
61' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
60' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Daniele Chiffi saw the whole situation.
59' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
57' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) replacing Nikola Krstovic.
57' That will be all from Raoul Bellanova who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta).
57' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) plays a one-two with Raoul Bellanova, but the move breaks down.

56' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a comfortable save.
52' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) receives a precise pass outside the penalty area and strikes the ball goalwards. His attempt only finds one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
51' Alisson Santos (Napoli) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
48' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
47' Goal disallowed! Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) scores but Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Raffaele Palladino makes a switch. Lazar Samardzic is coming on in place of Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+2' Alisson Santos (Napoli) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom left corner, but Marco Carnesecchi makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Daniele Chiffi decides there was no infringement by Isak Hien (Atalanta) and the game can continue.
45' The Napoli players are stunned as referee Daniele Chiffi changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
43' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Napoli using VAR. Let's see what happens.
42' The booking goes to Isak Hien (Atalanta).
42' Daniele Chiffi blows the whistle, Isak Hien (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Napoli.
40' A pass into the box finds Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic denies him.
37' Juan Jesus (Napoli) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
36' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

35' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
35' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:3.
32' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
31' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) tries to find Raoul Bellanova, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
30' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
30' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic punches the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atalanta.
29' Alisson Santos (Napoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
28' The game is interrupted. Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
25' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) commits a foul and Daniele Chiffi immediately signals a free kick.
25' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
22' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alisson Santos (Napoli) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
21' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

18' 0 - 1 Superbly taken set piece! Miguel Gutierrez takes the free kick and sends a cross into the six-yard box. Sam Beukema (Napoli) flicks the ball lightly with his head towards the top of the net. Marco Carnesecchi can't react quickly enough and the score changes to 0:1.
17' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) brings an opponent down and Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game. Napoli win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
16' Handball by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
13' Sam Beukema (Napoli) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
12' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
11' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) plays a through ball but overhits it.
9' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic intercepts the ball.

7' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a comfortable save.
4' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
3' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
3' Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
3' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
2' The ball is cleared after Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Napoli will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
